text.zh-CN: 脑内出血是血管破裂后，血液进入脑组织或脑室造成的急症。血肿和周围肿胀可压迫脑组织，需要尽快影像检查与专科处理。
text.en: Intracerebral hemorrhage is an emergency involving bleeding into brain tissue or the ventricles. The hematoma and surrounding swelling can compress the brain, requiring rapid imaging and specialist care.

text.zh-CN: 部位名称描述出血在哪里：深部半球与脑叶位于大脑，脑干与小脑位于后颅窝；脑室是脑内脑脊液流经的腔隙。部位影响观察重点，但不能单凭名字预测个人结局。
text.en: Location names describe where bleeding occurs: deep hemispheric and lobar bleeds involve the cerebrum; the brainstem and cerebellum lie in the posterior fossa. Ventricles are fluid-filled spaces. Location informs care but alone does not predict an individual outcome.

text.zh-CN: 单纯脑室出血没有同时显示的脑实质出血；多部位出血可包括脑实质与脑室同时出血，要评估每处病灶及整体影响；“部位未定”表示仍需影像明确，不能据此认为较轻。
text.en: Isolated ventricular bleeding has no accompanying parenchymal bleed on imaging. Multiple-site bleeding can include combined parenchymal and ventricular bleeding and requires assessment of all lesions and their combined effects. An unspecified site calls for imaging clarification, not an assumption of mild disease.

text.zh-CN: 脑内出血可来自小血管病，也可继发于凝血问题、血管畸形、肿瘤或脑梗死后的出血转化。后几类需要原病与出血共同评估，不能把普通自发性脑出血的所有方案直接套用；外伤及蛛网膜下腔出血另走相应路径。
text.en: Intracerebral bleeding may arise from small-vessel disease or follow a coagulation disorder, vascular malformation, tumour or hemorrhagic transformation of an infarct. These secondary causes require assessment of both the underlying disease and bleeding, so not every primary-ICH recommendation applies unchanged. Trauma and subarachnoid hemorrhage follow their corresponding pathways.

text.zh-CN: 长期高血压可损伤脑内小血管，深部出血常见这一背景；脑叶出血尤其在年长者，还要考虑脑淀粉样血管病，即异常蛋白沉积使血管容易出血。部位是线索，不是病因证明。
text.en: Chronic hypertension damages small brain vessels and commonly underlies deep bleeds. Lobar bleeding, particularly in older people, also raises concern for cerebral amyloid angiopathy, in which protein deposits make vessels prone to bleeding. Location is a clue, not proof.

text.en: Anticoagulants or clotting disorders can worsen bleeding; structural abnormalities such as vascular malformations may also cause it. Clinicians therefore need the medicine history and may investigate the vessels.

text.en: Subarachnoid bleeding is mainly in the spaces around the brain and often presents with a sudden severe headache. Traumatic hemorrhage has a different trigger. History and imaging determine whether bleeding patterns coexist.

text.en: Teams monitor consciousness, breathing and blood pressure in a stroke unit or intensive care and control pressure according to the case. Acute targets and pace require monitoring, not extra home antihypertensives taken independently.

text.en: Cerebellar bleeding with neurological deterioration, brainstem compression or hydrocephalus often needs urgent neurosurgical assessment and evacuation. A fixed number of hours is not a reason to delay help.

text.zh-CN: 脑室积血可能阻碍脑脊液流动。脑积水影响意识时，可能放置脑室外引流管排液、减压；单纯脑室出血也需评估这条路径，而不是只关注脑组织内血肿。
text.en: Blood in the ventricles can obstruct cerebrospinal fluid flow. Hydrocephalus affecting consciousness may require an external ventricular drain to remove fluid and relieve pressure; isolated ventricular bleeding also needs this assessment.

text.zh-CN: 深部或脑叶出血的清除手术需结合位置、体积、临床变化和手术风险选择。脑干出血也不能直接套用小脑清除血肿的建议，应由具备神经重症与神经外科能力的团队判断。
text.en: Evacuation of deep or lobar bleeding depends on location, volume, clinical change and surgical risk. Cerebellar evacuation recommendations cannot simply be applied to brainstem hemorrhage; specialist neurocritical and neurosurgical assessment is needed.

text.en: With brainstem involvement, the team pays particular attention to airway protection and ongoing breathing and consciousness assessment, with intake guided by swallowing assessment. Respiratory support is provided when needed; surgery is a separate decision based on the lesion and risks.

text.en: For anticoagulant-associated bleeding, the hospital considers reversal; different anticoagulants need different approaches. Give the team the medicine name and last dose time rather than treating all blood thinners as interchangeable.

text.en: Antiseizure treatment is used for appropriate indications such as seizures, rather than routinely for everyone. Restarting an antiplatelet or anticoagulant requires renewed balancing of clotting and bleeding risks.

text.zh-CN: 例如华法林属于维生素 K 拮抗剂，相关脑出血常用凝血酶原复合物补充凝血因子，并配合静脉维生素 K。达比加群属于另一类抗凝药，其特异逆转药是依达赛珠单抗；不能相互替代。
text.en: Warfarin is a vitamin K antagonist; associated ICH is commonly treated with prothrombin complex concentrate to replace clotting factors together with intravenous vitamin K. Dabigatran is a different anticoagulant with the specific reversal agent idarucizumab; these approaches are not interchangeable.
